svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hub: 14 mm of 28 mm round bar, bored 20 mm, with an M6 set screw.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arm: 12 x 6 mm flat bar 83 mm long, screwed or welded to the hub,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its far end 95 mm from the axle centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Handle: 18 mm round bar or a bought crank handle, 50 mm long, on an

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M8 shoulder bolt through the arm 90 mm from the axle, free to turn.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: hub on the left end of the axle, against the bearing; set screw

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: onto a flat filed on the axle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the handle turns freely on its bolt.
